_note: 2_03 'The Eggs' — dress up preppy, buy eggs, deliver them to Tad's house; the handoff is an ambush: egg-chucking preps in the yard, then beat the gate key out of the keymaster and get out (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_03-the-eggs.md). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the dress-code gate (player_wearing R_Sweater1/5, refuses to start) is skipped — there is no clothing system yet (the sweater grant itself is a collectible flag in the campaign on_pass, same posture as the ch1 outfits); the egg-money floor is real (money_ensure $2 at the start — the original tops up in CENTS (150 = $1.50); our wallet counts whole dollars) but the broke-and-eggless fail watchdog is moot once the floor exists, so it is skipped; the two baked cutscenes (2-03, 2-03b) are title-card + speech beats; the repeatable no-eggs rebuff scene is skipped (the delivery is a social gated on having the eggs); the six window eggers are stationary target dummies (no ranged egg-tree AI, no restock thread, no cover registration) and are color, not required kills; the pick-a-keymaster choice (front vs back, the other vanishes) is compressed to the front-gate keymaster; the gate props' lock/open choreography is dialogue color (the yard is open geometry for us); the getaway 'leave TadHouse trigger' pass is a reach beat outside the back gate (trigger_exit exists but the smoke driver has no exit-drive yet — leave-zone passes stay reach beats until it does); item 362 KO drops skipped (OPEN in the recon); g2_03/gHasTadKey world flags skipped (consumers outside the file). Tad's death fail at the delivery is declared but latent (the trio is invulnerable until the ambush, matching the original's min-health floor). The MINI_Lock group is anim dressing in the original (VERIFIED no minigame call) — no lockpick beat here. Pass grants the Aquaberry sweater via the campaign on_pass (SMissPass R_Sweater1, VERIFIED); the preppies -10 respect is relative and omitted (table is set-only). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: The Eggs

stages.objective: Tad has a little job for you.

on_start.sub: An invitation from the Aquaberry set.

lines.speaker: TAD
lines.text: You're the new boy. Fetch us some eggs from the store and bring them here — there's a good errand runner.

on_start.text: The store is back toward town. Watch your wallet.

on_complete.speaker: CLERK
on_complete.text: One carton of eggs. Tell the Aquaberry boys their account is getting thick.

stages.objective: Deliver the eggs to Tad's house.
It's a trap! Fight off the preps.

lines.speaker: TAD
lines.text: Did you really think we'd let the help walk in here? Get him, boys — and eggs away!

stages.objective: One of them has the gate key. Take it.

on_start.speaker: KEYMASTER
on_start.text: You'll leave when we say you leave, pauper!

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: Got the key. Time to go.
campaign on_pass for 2_03 grants the Aquaberry sweater (R_Sweater1 collectible flag); preppies -10 respect omitted (relative vs set-only table); gHasTadKey world flag skipped
